**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is looking for new recipe ideas, specifically for Korean dishes.  
[EVENT] User ordered food delivery from a new Korean place downtown exactly two weeks ago.  
[TEMPORAL] The food delivery occurred on a Thursday, two weeks prior to the session date of 2023/05/23.  
[FACT] User received spicy pork bibimbap from the restaurant, which they found amazing.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in trying out different variations of bibimbap.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bibimbap literally means "mixed rice" in Korean and is made with a variety of vegetables, meat (usually beef), and a fried egg, served over rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a simple bibimbap recipe including ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for the bibimbap recipe include:  
- 1 cup Korean short-grain rice (or Japanese short-grain rice)  
- 2 cups water  
- 1 tablespoon sesame oil  
- 1 teaspoon salt  
- 1 cup bean sprouts  
- 1 cup shredded zucchini  
- 1 cup diced carrots  
- 1 cup diced cucumber  
- 1/2 cup diced bell peppers  
- 1/2 cup diced mushrooms  
- 1/4 cup chopped green onions  
- 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds  
- 1/2 cup diced beef (ribeye or sirloin), marinated in:  
  - 2 tablespoons soy sauce  
  - 2 tablespoons Gochujang (Korean chili paste)  
  - 2 tablespoons brown sugar  
  - 2 cloves garlic, minced  
  - 1 tablespoon sesame oil  
- 1 egg  
- Salt and pepper to taste  
- 2 tablespoons Gochujang  
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce  
- 2 tablespoons rice vinegar  
- 1 tablespoon honey  
- 1 teaspoon grated ginger  
- 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips and variations for bibimbap, including using spicy pork or tofu for a vegetarian option and adding kimchi for extra flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided three variations of spicy pork bibimbap recipes, including ingredients and instructions for each.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe 1: Spicy Pork Bibimbap with Gochujang Sauce includes:  
- 1/2 cup diced pork shoulder or butt, marinated in:  
  - 2 tablespoons Gochujang  
  - 2 tablespoons soy sauce  
  - 2 tablespoons brown sugar  
  - 2 cloves garlic, minced  
  - 1 tablespoon sesame oil  
  - 1 teaspoon crushed black pepper  
- 1/4 cup Gochujang sauce (store-bought or homemade)
